acceptance_criteria.description: Launcher storage and image inputs accept only local filesystem paths and rejected credential-bearing values are never echoed
The registered readiness argv is frozen and no-sync and schema validation rejects drift
NatureBench code and protocol remain unchanged
Focused Python 3.12 tests collaboration validation and lab doctor pass

objective: Reject URI or credential-bearing readiness locators and make the registered Apptainer probe invocation frozen and no-sync without changing NatureBench.
title: Harden Apptainer readiness locators and no-sync invocation
